subjects.title: Architecture and repository boundaries
subjects.purpose: Defines the SDK/API/browser boundary, repository roles, and product-scoped Supabase ownership.

subjects.title: SDK and product-facing API
subjects.purpose: Defines the public `@class-kit/react` client, React context, and product-facing API methods and response shapes.

subjects.title: Product resolution, authentication, and access
subjects.purpose: Defines origin resolution, auth policy/provider outcomes, access-entry states, and activation of product membership.

subjects.title: Authorization and roles
subjects.purpose: Defines platform/product scope, level/key precedence, roles, permission grants, and capability derivation.

subjects.title: Classes and registrations
subjects.purpose: Defines public/managed class views, class and registration states, and the precedence of access, eligibility, membership, capacity, approval, and cancellation gates.

subjects.title: Templates, schedules, and attendance
subjects.purpose: Defines template defaults, schedule recurrence/status, generated-class controls, skip rules, and attendance lifecycle and participant outcomes.

subjects.title: Memberships and entitlements
subjects.purpose: Defines membership modes, grant and ledger states, stock/validity eligibility, and manager lifecycle operations.

subjects.title: Product documents and signup links
subjects.purpose: Defines document visibility/version/acceptance states and public or managed signup-link behavior.

subjects.title: Product administration and reset
subjects.purpose: Defines platform administration of products, origins, auth policy/redirects, product users/roles, and irreversible truncation.

subjects.title: Change requests and project-management integration
subjects.purpose: Defines request and attachment states, revision and soft-delete behavior, platform review, and Trello work-item lifecycle.

subjects.title: Operator workflows and local apps
subjects.purpose: Defines local stack, verification and deployment workflows, SDK release, and the administrative and Demo2 application consumers.
